summary: iteration_6 verification: created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6.py (27 tests) and removed the xfail in test_iteration5.py::TestNoiseFilter. Full suite: 101 tests, 100 passed / 1 failed (a newly-found real bug, see below). All 9 requested fixes verified: 'K C' + Gmail-chrome-URL noise filtering, whitespace-tolerant date normalization ('06- Jun-2026' -> <DATE>), PDF subject extraction (subject.mockup == 'Your balance update', score 90.48), link partial credit (link_stats.pct 0.44 / scores.links 44), compare_field empty flag, overall_score 54.42 (>=50, was 37.92), uat_tool.spec hiddenimports (lxml/lxml.etree/soupsieve/html5lib/sqlite3), DiffReport dynamic mockupExt/outputExt passed to all 6 DiffRow instances. E2E on the public preview: AmEx PDF+EML upload -> diff-report, score-overall 54.42%, score-subject 90%, diff-body-0 'Dear KIRTIMAAN CHHABRA,' MATCH on both sides with headers 'MOCKUP (.PDF)' / 'OUTPUT (.EML)', zero console/pageerror/runtime-overlay. Regressions verified: all result tabs, PDF+HTML export downloads, reset, history sidebar, glossary, batch nav, Guide copy (10 formats, one-click bundle, build.sh, pptx/xlsx/csv/msg) and PRD download button.

minor.issue: Empty-vs-empty exclusion is incomplete: both use `total = max(len(a), len(b)) or 1`, so when NEITHER side has links/images stats become {total:1, pct:0.0}. compare()._has_content then sees total>0 and keeps the links (0.10) and images (0.10) weights with score 0. Result: a document pair that matches 100% on subject/greeting/body/footer with no links and no images scores 75.00 instead of 100.00. Fix: return total=0 (and pct=1.0 / excluded) when both sides are empty, mirroring the compare_field 'empty' handling. Repro test: tests/test_iteration6.py::TestEmptySectionExclusion::test_empty_links_and_images_should_not_penalise (currently failing by design).

issues: A bare 'http://localhost:3000' link is rendered as an anchor in the guide copy; harmless for the offline bundle description but shows as a clickable dead link in the hosted preview.
'Download PRD (.docx)' appears twice in the collected control labels — verify it is not a duplicated button.

Rows whose mockup and output text are byte-identical (e.g. 'Last statement balance') are shown as WARNING because of the PLACEMENT INCORRECT flag. Behaviour looks intentional but the 'warning' status on a 100%-similar row is confusing to UAT users — consider a distinct 'placement-only' badge.

action_items: Fix compare_links/compare_images so both-sides-empty yields total=0 and is excluded from the weighted overall score (currently caps a perfect match at 75%).
critical_code_review_comments: compare()._has_content('links'/'images') relies on stats['total'] which is forced to >=1 by `max(len(a),len(b)) or 1` — the 'or 1' defeats the new empty-section exclusion logic. Return 0 and let pct fall back to 1.0/excluded.
comparator.py is still ~1000 lines (deferred per note) — scoring/weights should move to its own module when refactored.
seed_data_creation: None new; used /app/backend/samples/amex PDF+EML pair and /tmp/uat_stubs generated by the iteration_5 fixtures. Compare runs used save_history=false except the two E2E preview runs (2 extra history rows).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q` (pytest.ini already sets -n 2 --dist loadscope). Only known failing test is TestEmptySectionExclusion::test_empty_links_and_images_should_not_penalise which documents the links/images total=1 bug — it should pass once compare_links/compare_images return total=0 for empty-vs-empty. Note UI text is CSS-uppercased, so assert on '(.PDF)' / '(.EML)' when using inner_text. Result tab testids are result-tab-{subject,body,cta,images,footer} (the URLs tab id is not 'result-tab-urls').
rca_of_the_issue: compare_links/compare_images normalise their denominator with `total = max(len(a), len(b)) or 1` to avoid divide-by-zero. When neither side has links/images this yields total=1 with 0 matches → pct 0.0. compare()'s new _has_content() gate checks `total > 0`, which is always true, so the 0.10+0.10 weights are applied with a 0 score, deflating the overall score by up to 25 points for link/image-free content.
